column1: # A row is one sense of one phrase. Pins are position=reading, and exist ONLY
# where a character reads differently from the corpus principal - so every pin
# marks a place a reader would otherwise guess wrong. Position, not glyph:
# 慢慢地走 repeats 慢, and two glyph-keyed pins could not be told apart.
# 东西 carries two senses that are not even read alike - dongxi for the object,
# dong-xi for the directions. It is sense 1 that shows 东 = east.
